title: Address-Amendment Rate — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Rate Table
content:
The address-amendment rate for an address amendment on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate follows the amendments on the filing's record.

| Filing's record shows | Address-amendment rate |
|---|---|
| An amendment entered today | 5.00 |
| No amendment entered today, but two or more amendments within the past 12 months | 20.00 |
| Every other case | The certificate's amended filing fee |

**Order of the lines.** The lines are read from the top: an amendment entered today sets the rate at 5.00 whatever the 12-month count.

**What counts.** Every amendment entry on the filing's record counts, whatever its reason (vehicle change, address change, policy number change, name change). "Entered today" means an amendment entry whose entry date is today.

**Window.** A window of a number of months covers the entries dated less than that many whole months before today, whole months being counted from the entry's date to today.

## Rate notes (hypothetical records)

| Amendments on the filing's record | Rate |
|---|---|
| A vehicle change entered today; two others in the past year | 5.00 |
| None today; a name change 4 months ago and a policy number change 7 months ago | 20.00 |
| None today; one address change 5 months ago | The certificate's amended filing fee |
| None today; two amendments, one 3 months ago and one 13 months ago | The certificate's amended filing fee (only one is within 12 months) |
| None at all | The certificate's amended filing fee |
